data.desc: Amer Sports is a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic. Our brands are known for their detailed craftsmanship, unwavering authenticity, and premium market positioning. As creators of exceptional apparel, footwear, and equipment, we pride ourselves on cutting-edge innovation, performance, and designs that allow elite athletes and everyday consumers to perform their best. Our purpose is to elevate the world through sport, and our vision is to be the best sporting goods company in the world. With corporate offices in Helsinki, Munich, Krakow, New York, and Shanghai, we have operations in 40 countries and our products are sold in 100+ countries. In 2025, Amer Sports generated $6.6 billion of revenue and had over 15,400 employees globally at year-end. Amer Sports, Inc. shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
